title: Sandhippu
overview: Two respected families are torn apart by betrayal, murder, and a temple robbery. Years later, a boxer and club waiter discovers his long-lost father is a feared underworld don—and the key to restoring justice. Packed with family drama, romance, and thrilling revelations, Emanukku Eman is a gripping tale of revenge, reunion, and redemption. A classic masala entertainer you won’t want to miss.
